title: The fixed integral reduction-tower data and predicates
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, and a scheme T, with the coefficients and ordinary module-sheaf derived categories of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Reconstruct the section ring of the pulled-back condensed integer sheaf by [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], and its exact section/internal derived equivalence. Keep the unique projection-normalized abelian completed-ring comparison of [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit] and its ell-power projections. For a tower presentation D of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], reduction data consists of: an isomorphism to the completed coefficient ring with precisely that abelian map; an additive ordinary strict tower functor with levelwise scalar-extension isomorphisms and quotient transitions on local pure tensors; its universal left-derived functor, comparison invertible on all K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], and evaluation isomorphisms; invertibility of every specified reduction adjunct [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]; and, on qcqs T, preservation of bounded constructibility, finite Tor amplitude and every Tor interval as both Tor and cohomological bounds [sk-def-sfb-constructible, det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. These are the original SpReductionTower and its auxiliary definitions, relocated verbatim; the definition makes no assertion of existence.
